Teen Arrested for School Shooting Threat Targeting Hindu Temple

A teenage boy has been arrested in connection with an alleged mass shooting plot that may have targeted an Aurora Hindu temple. The arrest followed a shooting threat made outside a London school, where the teen reportedly threatened children with a knife. Parents expressed alarm over the incident at Crete-Monee High School.
